lines.text: And here is the real thing: the same kind of organization in a language model's own map. This is the period-five shrimp of Qwen two point five, steered at two layers and followed cell by cell, with its fold curves in black and its flip curves in red.

Where its upper leg leaves the body, the fold curve has two cusps that share a segment, and its other branches cross: a section of a swallowtail. At thirteen points fixed in advance, the number of period-five orbits matched the swallowtail's prediction at nine.

Two of the cusps we located are of the node kind, the kind that organizes crossroad and spring areas. Whether they make a crossroad or a spring in the model's map is still open, and that search is under way.
